# Geovane Souza

> Portfolio of Geovane Souza, Product Manager and Software Engineer focused on applied AI, based in Salvador, Bahia, Brazil.

This Portuguese-language site describes Geovane's work across digital product strategy and delivery, applied AI, UX/design, software engineering, and business operations. It includes selected project work, operating businesses, professional recognition, recommendations, a short biography, and contact options.

## Key pages

- [Home and portfolio](https://geovanesouza.com/): overview, six areas of work, selected digital products, businesses, recognition, biography, and contact.
- [About Geovane Souza](https://geovanesouza.com/sobre/): professional profile and working approach.
- [Contact](https://geovanesouza.com/contato/): public email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and résumé.
- [Privacy](https://geovanesouza.com/privacidade/): notes on analytics, external links, and data handling.
- [Markdown homepage](https://geovanesouza.com/index.md): concise text representation of the site.

## Selected projects

- Atlas AI: internal EA ecosystem tool integrating MCPs and APIs to automate decisions, surface operational risks, and streamline processes with Claude.
- Cuida e Amor: learning platform and site for training caregivers of older adults.
- EduServen: educational management SaaS for public and private schools.
- Dot10: website and digital platform project for iGaming.

## Businesses

- [Young DevOps](https://youngdevops.com.br): tech house for custom digital product development; Geovane is a partner focused on product and AI.
- [LeadFinder](https://leadfinderbr.com): B2B prospecting SaaS; Geovane is a partner and Product Manager & Ops.
- [GeoServices Tech](https://geoservices.tech): technical support for computers and digital equipment.
- [JovnArt | gs™](https://www.instagram.com/jovnart/): fashion and curation project.
- [Portal da Reputação](https://www.portaldareputacao.com/): digital product about company and service reputation, currently in development.

## Public evidence

The site reports five professional performance recognitions, more than ten LinkedIn recommendations, and Brazilian computer-program registration BR512025000624-1, granted by INPI on 2025-02-18. These are claims presented by the portfolio owner; consult the linked profile and INPI record for independent confirmation.
